body.name: Graph-conditioned unrestricted minimax risk
body.construction: \(R(G)=\inf_{\mathcal D_G\in\Delta(\{0,1\}^{V_n}),\,\widehat\tau}\sup_{y\in\mathcal M_n(G)}\mathbb E_{Z\sim\mathcal D_G,y}[(\widehat\tau(Z,Y^{\mathrm{obs}};G)-\tau_n)^2]\), where the estimator is measurable in only the displayed observed data and \(G\).
